userFit.title: Your collection grows. So does the clutter.
userFit.subtitle: When you buy from several stores, it's easy to lose track of what you paid, what's left and what's on the way.

card1.title: Orders everywhere
card1.description: Confirmations in your inbox, screenshots on your phone, messages in chats. Your collection lives in ten different places.

card2.title: «Did I already pay for this?»
card2.description: Between deposits, balances and pre-orders, remembering how much you owe and to whom becomes a headache.

card3.title: Deliveries you can't keep track of
card3.description: Orders that arrive in parts and dates that slip by. You find out late, or never.

features.title: Everything you need to keep your collection up to date
features.subtitle: From the purchase to the moment it reaches your hands, PandaTrack is with you every step of the way.

stores.title: Trusted stores
stores.description: Save the stores you buy from and recognize at a glance the ones you already know.

orders.title: Your orders, organized
orders.description: Log every order from any store, with its products and cost, in one clear list.

preorders.title: Pre-orders without surprises
preorders.description: Keep track of what you've put a deposit on and what's still left to pay, order by order.

deliveries.title: Deliveries, even split ones
deliveries.description: Follow every delivery and easily handle orders that arrive in several shipments.

reminders.title: Reminders on time
reminders.description: We remind you of a payment or a key date before it slips by, for you.

dashboard.title: Everything at a glance
dashboard.description: See the status of your orders, upcoming payments and how much you've spent, all on one screen.

banner.title: Your collection deserves to be in order
banner.subtitle: Create your free account and bring your orders, payments and deliveries together in one place. It takes less than a minute.

items.question: Is PandaTrack free?
items.answer: Yes, it's free to start and you don't need a card. You can register your stores, orders and deliveries without paying anything.

items.question: Does it work with any store?
items.answer: Yes. PandaTrack doesn't depend on any particular store: you log your orders wherever they come from, online or in person.

items.question: Do I have to enter everything by hand?
items.answer: You add each order to stay in control of what you're tracking. We designed it to be fast: a few taps and it's saved.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Your collection is yours alone. We keep your information private and never share it with stores or other collectors.

items.question: What languages is it in?
items.answer: PandaTrack is available in Spanish and English, and you can switch languages anytime from your account.

footer.tagline: Your whole collection in one place: orders, pre-orders and deliveries.
